scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run runtime:ts:build && vite build
scripts.test:compat: vitest run runtime-ts/tests/providers.test.ts runtime-ts/tests/mcp.test.ts runtime-ts/tests/tools.test.ts runtime-ts/tests/runtime.test.ts
scripts.verify:rc: npm run build && npm test -- --run && npm run test:electron
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:rc && npm run test:visual && npm run test:scale
scripts.verify:package: npm run package:mac:zip && npm run release:scan && npm run test:electron:packaged
scripts.package:mac:zip: npm run build && npm run icon:generate && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --mac zip --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:mac:dmg: npm run build && npm run icon:generate && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --mac dmg --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:mac:release: npm run build && npm run icon:generate && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --mac dmg zip --config electron-builder.release.cjs && npm run release:scan && npm run release:artifacts
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --win --config electron-builder.json
